subject: general
question: Which two dairy products have been completely exempted from GST under the government’s recent GST reforms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Milk and Paneer.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Centre’s GST reforms provided direct relief in the dairy sector by exempting Milk and Paneer, whether branded or unbranded, from GST.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Milk and Paneer are now GST-free, lowering household costs and improving nutrition security.**
 
• **Over 10 crore dairy farmers will directly benefit from these exemptions.**
 
• **Women-led rural enterprises and cooperatives engaged in dairy processing gain competitiveness.**
 
• **Other dairy items like Butter and Ghee had their GST reduced to 5%, but were not fully exempted.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Butter & Ghee__

 __
 
• GST reduced from 12% to 5%.
 
• Improves affordability and supports dairy cooperatives.
 
 
 
• Cheese & Other Foods__
 __
 
• Cheese, pasta, namkeens, jams, jellies, and juice-based drinks now taxed at 5%.
 
• Aims to reduce household expenditure and encourage food processing growth.
 
 
 
• Farm Inputs__
 __
 
• Fertiliser inputs like ammonia, sulphuric acid, and nitric acid GST cut to 5%.
 
• Bio-pesticides and micronutrients also reduced to 5%, encouraging organic farming.
 
 
 
• Logistics__
 
 
• Trucks and delivery vans GST reduced to 18% from 28%.
 
• Third-party insurance of goods carriage reduced to 5% with ITC, easing logistics costs.
